sections.content: Cooking recipes and manual instructions frequently use imperative commands, often combined with sequence markers: primero (first), luego (then), después (afterwards), finalmente (finally).

sections.title: Common Culinary Imperatives
rows: añade (tú) / añada (ud.) una pizca de sal

items.spanish: Primero, corte las cebollas en trozos pequeños.
items.english: First, cut the onions into small pieces.

items.spanish: Luego, mezcle los huevos con una pizca de sal.
items.english: Then, mix the eggs with a pinch of salt.
